title: Abandoned
subtitle: A Borderline Personality Disorder Poem
author: William Saville
content:
I stand breathless,
On the precipice of forever,
Cheeks stained by tears,
Forever too long however.
Eyes wide and sorrowful,
Heart yearning for something,
Love come and gone,
Never lasting always fleeting.
I wring my hands in agony,
At the aloneness of it all,
The vast endlessness of fear,
That I'm doomed to stumble and fall.
Scars upon my flesh by me,
Scars upon my heart by women and men,
I wish I could rip my own heart out,
And destroy it before again another can.
I feel hollow day and night,
I've lived so much in so short a life,
Given all of myself completely,
But cut repeatedly by love's brutal knife.
Is there hope for me at all?
Or am I doomed to break myself for others?
To rip my own heart to pieces,
And give them to each of my lovers?
Relationships, engagements, marriages,
Abandonment and broken words,
Promises made to win affection,
But I'm left feeling lame and absurd.
I shout out from the nightmares,
Reliving the pain I've received,
Still reeling from the trauma,
And the false promises I've believed.
